messages:
lara (devex): support ping: customer on Win11+WSL2 says `redwoodctl login` reports "saved token" but their local quickstart still 401s. they launched from Start Menu.
ben (eng-cli): are they using MSI or manual binary?
lara (devex): MSI. they insisted they followed quickstart.
kevin (eng-runtime): likely symptom: binary resolved HOME to /mnt/c/... when started from Start Menu shim. token written to /mnt/c path that their WSL shell doesn't treat as their native home.
tess (devops): we've seen AV or corporate file filters prevent writes to C:\ mounts from WSL processes. do we detect write errors?
ben (eng-cli): we log success even when write fails. that's bad.
lara (devex): user didn't see any error; CLI output said "Saved token to ~/.config/redwood/profiles/default.json" and exit 0.
kevin (eng-runtime): immediate fixes: 1) make writes atomic and validate by reopening file after write, 2) error nonzero if write fails, 3) when running on Linux inside WSL, prefer native /home path if it exists and appears writable.
tess (devops): installer side: if MSI shim is used, maybe it should set RWCTL_HOST_CONTEXT=windows-shim so CLI can detect and warn when HOME points to a foreign mount.
ben (eng-cli): i can add a small heuristic: if running under WSL (check /proc/version) and HOME starts with /mnt/, print a one-line warning and suggestion: "Run login from a WSL shell or set XDG_CONFIG_HOME to $HOME/.config to persist token in WSL."
lara (devex): that message plus an FAQ link would reduce tickets. add steps for headless CI too.
auto-bot: attached logs from report (token redacted):
```
INFO auth: write attempt to /mnt/c/Users/alice/.config/redwood/profiles/default.json
ERROR auth: open /mnt/c/Users/alice/.config/redwood/profiles/default.json: permission denied
INFO cli: login completed
```
kevin (eng-runtime): see, write error occurred but we didn't propagate. ben, can you make the writer return an explicit error instead of swallow?
ben (eng-cli): yes. patch plan: - wrap os.WriteFile with tmpfile+rename - set file mode 0600 - after rename, stat file and confirm owner/perm - if any step fails, print helpful diagnosis and exit 1.
tess (devops): also add a fallback: if write target is on a mount that looks like Windows host (/mnt/c,...), check for existence of /home/<user> and offer to write there when running inside WSL (only if writable). present as a prompt when interactive.
lara (devex): support workaround I'll paste into tickets: 1) open your WSL distro shell 2) run `which redwoodctl` to ensure it's the same binary 3) run `env HOME="$HOME" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$HOME/.config" redwoodctl login` 4) verify `ls -la ~/.config/redwood/profiles`
kevin (eng-runtime): longer-term: add `redwoodctl doctor` to check common install/profile drift (multiple binaries on PATH, env vars set, XDG vs legacy files present) and output a short remediation script.
ben (eng-cli): i'll raise GH issue GH#6120 and assign myself for the write-fix + CLI warning, and kevin for the WSL home preference logic. tess, can you handle installer shim flag and docs update?
tess (devops): on it. i'll also add a blurb to the MSI postinstall that warns about launching from Start Menu on WSL setups.
auto-bot: created ticket GH#6120: "redwoodctl reports saved token but write can fail on WSL/Windows shim; improve write handling and warnings"
lara (devex): thanks team. once PRs land i'll close support cases with the workaround and doc link. :sparkles:
